subject: Matemática
description_pt: Interpretar e resolver situações que envolvam dados de pesquisas sobre contextos ambientais, sustentabilidade, trânsito, consumo responsável, entre outros, apresentadas pela mídia em tabelas e em diferentes tipos de gráficos e redigir textos escritos com o objetivo de sintetizar conclusões.

components.description_pt: Interpretar dados apresentados em tabelas e gráficos sobre temas como questões ambientais ou sociais
components.description_en: Interpret data presented in tables and graphs on topics such as environmental or social issues
components.cc_component_description: Interpret key features of graphs and tables that represent a function that models a real world relationship between two quantities

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas usando dados de pesquisa extraídos de fontes de mídia
components.description_en: Solve problems using survey data drawn from media sources
components.cc_component_description: Solve two-step problems using information presented in a scaled bar graph

components.description_pt: Compor um texto escrito resumindo conclusões a partir de dados apresentados em gráficos ou tabelas
components.description_en: Compose a written text summarizing conclusions from data presented in graphs or tables
components.cc_component_description: Interpret a two-way table summarizing data

cc_matches.description: Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories. Solve one- and two-step "how many more" and "how many less" problems using information presented in scaled bar graphs. *For example, draw a bar graph in which each square in the bar graph might represent 5 pets.*

Understand that patterns of association can also be seen in bivariate categorical data by displaying frequencies and relative frequencies in a two-way table. Construct and interpret a two-way table summarizing data on two categorical variables collected from the same subjects. Use relative frequencies calculated for rows or columns to describe possible association between the two variables. *For example, collect data from students in your class on whether or not they have a curfew on school nights and whether or not they have assigned chores at home. Is there evidence that those who have a curfew also tend to have chores?*

For a function that models a relationship between two quantities, interpret key features of graphs and tables in terms of the quantities, and sketch graphs showing key features given a verbal description of the relationship.
